changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE users ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE, name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ROLE_USER', uuid UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW() );

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_users_email ON users(email); CREATE INDEX idx_users_uuid ON users(uuid);

changeSet.author: rostyslav
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS password VARCHAR(255);
